title: Negative control: a structural bound whose entry states no rationale
description: The subschema below says plenty, and none of it is attached to the number. A structural bound has no citation to go stale, so the only thing standing between it and a limit chosen to make something pass is a stated reason - and the reason has to sit in the entry for that bound rather than in prose the whole subschema shares. It is never loaded as a real schema.

presentation_id.description: Omitted when a definition never appears in-world, and the empty string is what the compiler materializes for an omitted field.
